value.summary: This pull request only changes a use path alias, replacing `openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` with `openhuman_core as oh`.  The change is a safe refactoring; it introduces no security issues, no new dependencies, no network calls, no deserialization of untrusted data, and no authentication or authorisation changes.  The diff is trivially small and has no observable effect on runtime behaviour.  Safe to merge.
